children: HelloFresh cut its full-year outlook after its back-to-school campaign yielded disappointing new-customer numbers, which raises questions about its marketing strategy, Stifel's Clement Genelot says in a research note. "[Full-year] guidance was known to be entirely dependent on the success of the back-to-school marketing campaign. But the explanation provided by HelloFresh raises even more questions about its ability to properly manage its marketing strategy, which will be key in any commercial inflection," the analyst says. The German meal-kit company attributed the profit warning to deeper cuts to its marketing spending in the third quarter than in the first half. This should raise questions about HelloFresh's ability to manage the strategy and rethink marketing channels, Genelot adds. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
